description.value: ShopRite is an independent, family-run retail chain that has been serving Northern Vancouver Island since 1956. The Alert Bay location is a two-storey general store with a full grocery department — including a bakery, delicatessen, fresh produce, and a cut-meat counter — on the main floor, and a hardware store carrying building supplies, power tools, and plumbing on the second floor. For a touring cyclist reaching Alert Bay by ferry, it is one of the most complete provisioning options in this remote island community.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM coordinates (50.5853915, -126.9288142) correspond to Alert Bay, BC, which matches the website's Alert Bay General Store subpage listing an address of 99 Fir Street, Alert Bay. The website confirms this is an independent BC company operating since 1956 — distinct from the US ShopRite cooperative despite sharing a name and despite OSM's brand:wikidata/brand:wikipedia tags pointing to the American chain. The Alert Bay store page explicitly lists a full grocery operation (bakery, deli, fresh produce, meat counter) on the main floor and a hardware store on the second floor, confirming it is a real, open general store.
concerns: OSM brand:wikidata (Q7501097) and brand:wikipedia tags incorrectly reference the US ShopRite cooperative; this is an unrelated independent BC retailer trading as 'ShopRite North Island' since 1956.
